notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
crt.sh queries certificate transparency logs — public records of every TLS certificate issued by CAs. Returns JSON output containing subdomains that the company may never have intended to surface publicly.

=== CHAINING ===
crt.sh JSON → jq to filter → deduplicate subdomains → resolve with host loop → filter to company-owned IPs → feed to Shodan/nmap for service enumeration.

=== WHY PASSIVE ===
No connection to the target — queries a third-party database. Certificate transparency logging is mandatory for CAs, so this is a complete record. Often reveals staging, dev, and admin subdomains.

=== LEGAL NOTE ===
Subdomains resolving to third-party providers (CDN, cloud) are not within scope without explicit permission from that provider. The resolution-filtering step is legally significant.
